notes: Own site (santanasmexfood.com) is a WordPress landing page with no menu page and no prices; ordering is via a native "Soo" app with no browser-reachable menu. Read Uber Eats schema.org JSON-LD (14 sections, 126 priced items); dropped "Most Ordered" carousel duplicate sample. Address on the JSON-LD matches work list street number. Cross-checked against DoorDash page-service JSON-LD (8 sections, 158 items, same address) - item names and most prices align but some differ by ~10-15% between the two platforms (e.g. Combination Plate $12.99 on DoorDash vs $14.50-14.99 on Uber Eats); neither source divides out cleanly against 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.20/1.25/1.30 (best case 27/126 landing round), so treated as genuine per-platform pricing rather than a markup. Cent distribution collapses on .00/.25/.50/.99 on both platforms. Filed Uber Eats as primary since it carries 6 more sections (Tacos, Tostadas, Tortas, Enchiladas, Seafood, Side Orders, Refreshments) that DoorDash omits.

name: Surf Brothers Teriyaki and Catering
notes: Router-listed tryperdiem.com storefront is a pure client-rendered SPA shell (no JSON-LD, no __NEXT_DATA__/__NUXT__, no API calls visible in the HTML) - genuinely needs a browser, consistent with Perdiem being on the do-not-burn-time list. The restaurant's other own-domain ordering link (order.surfbrothers.net) does not resolve (DNS failure). Filed instead from DoorDash marketplace JSON-LD (3 sections, 24 unique priced items after de-duping a repeated menu block; address 274 North El Camino Real, Encinitas matches work list). Cross-checked against Uber Eats (different owner) which matches to the cent on the majority of overlapping items (Chicken Plate $16.69, Combo Plate $16.99, Steak Plate $17.29, Don Burri Plate $14.69, Hawaiian Slider Plate $9.54) with a couple of minor per-platform differences (Lite Bite Chicken $11.85 DoorDash vs $10.79 Uber Eats; Bottle of Teriyaki Sauce $7.09 vs $7.25). Cent distribution collapses heavily on endings-in-9 (29/39/49/59/69/79/95/99/09 covering 20 of 24 items) - printed-menu pattern. Divisor sweep 1.04-1.30 never clears more than 4/24, so no markup found.

name: Dominick's Sandwiches
notes:
Static HTML site (address 1672 S. Mission Rd, Fallbrook matches work list exactly, footer confirms). Read the Daily Menu page's HTML tables directly (name/price columns paired by
-separated position within each , not a flattened-text guess): Cold Sandwiches, Hot Sandwiches, Lettuce Salads, Extras, Hot Entrees, Side Orders (96 items total). Side Orders and Hot Entrees needed a second hand-verified pass since their header/data-row markup differs slightly from the other sections (nested instead of a class on the ), but every price was read from the same raw HTML table cells, none invented. Excluded the separate Catering Menu page entirely as an adjunct - it prices "Meat & Cheese Platters" and "Hot Entrees" at per-person catering rates (e.g. "10.50/person") and Salads as bulk trays ("Serves 15-20"/"Serves 30-35"), not per-item retail prices. Cent distribution clusters on .70/.95/.80/.50/.25/.40/.60 (own pricing convention, Large = Small x ~1.478 consistently) with no clean markup divisor (best 27/96 at 1.10, well short of a full match) - expected since this is the restaurant's own static site with no delivery intermediary.
